course.title: Modern Iron and Steel Making
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: One steel plant is using an EAF to produce carbon steel from scrap. Now, the management(18) wants to produce stainless steel and is seeking your advice. Which route will you suggest? Give reasoning to justify your answer with detail description of the suggested method.
